# Carmel Valley Chess Club

> Carmel Valley Chess Club is the only dedicated chess club in Monterey County, California. Founded in 2026 by Coach JB (Justin Bradley), it offers after-school chess for kids ages 5–17, a summer day camp, USCF-rated tournaments, and monthly all-ages Family Chess Nights (donation-based, benefiting the club's youth scholarship fund).

## Quick facts

- **Name:** Carmel Valley Chess Club
- **Founder & Head Coach:** Justin "JB" Bradley — Arena Candidate Master, USCF Tournament Director, lifelong chess player, Carmel Valley father of two
- **Founded:** 2026
- **Location:** 9 Del Fino Place, Suite 201, Carmel Valley, CA 93924 (above Mika Sushi)
- **Phone:** (831) 392-7456
- **Email:** chessclubcv@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://cvchess.com
- **Service area:** Carmel Valley, Carmel-by-the-Sea, Monterey, Pacific Grove, Pebble Beach, Salinas, Marina, Seaside, Big Sur — all of Monterey County
- **Google Business Profile:** https://share.google/rvDUhiNVKxAf4l978
- **YouTube:** https://www.youtube.com/@CarmelValleyChessClub
- **Instagram:** https://instagram.com/chessclubcv
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/people/Carmel-Valley-Chess-Club/61581426884697/

## Programs

### After-School Chess (Youth, ages 5–17)
- Monday: 3:15pm and 4:30pm — Recreational League (open)
- Tuesday: 3:15pm — Recreational League (open); 4:30pm — All-Girls Recreational Chess League
- Thursday: 3:15pm — Middle & High School Recreational Chess League
- **Cost: $120/month per student** — sibling discount available
- Class capped at **8 students** — past 8, Coach JB is refereeing, not coaching
- Pre-registration required (no walk-ins)
- Recreational League format (open sessions plus All-Girls and Middle/High School leagues)
- Monthly Stripe invoice; same rate whether month has 3 or 5 class dates
- Register: https://cvchess.com/after-school.html

### Summer Chess Camp 2026
- **STATUS: SOLD OUT for 2026.** The single class is full. Email list subscribers get first access when 2027 registration opens: https://cvchess.com/summer-camp.html#waitlist
- Dates: June 15–19, 2026 (Monday–Friday)
- Hours: 9:00am – 3:00pm daily
- Cost: $500 all-inclusive
- Includes: chess instruction, pool days at CVCYC, meals every day, movie day, USCF membership, closing trophy ceremony
- Optional early drop-off (8am): $40/week. Late pickup (5pm): $60/week.
- Ages: 5–17. No chess experience required.
- Every camper leaves as a USCF-rated tournament player.
- More info: https://cvchess.com/summer-camp.html

### Family Chess Nights (All Ages)
- One Friday a month, 5:00 – 9:00pm. Open to all ages and all levels.
- **5–6pm:** Beginner instruction hour run by Coach JB (kids and grown-ups; no experience needed).
- **6–9pm:** Open play for the whole family, every level.
- **Cost:** Donation-based — give what you like. All proceeds benefit the club's youth scholarship fund.
- No registration; just show up.
- **2026 dates:** July 17 (first one), August 14, September 25, October 23, November 20, December 18.
- More info: https://cvchess.com/friday-nights.html

### USCF Rated Tournaments
- **STATUS:** The June 20, 2026 Carmel Valley Sushi Slam was POSTPONED — the field needed for a rated event didn't come together. More tournaments are coming; dates to be announced. Join the email list (cvchess.com/tournaments.html) to be first to know.
- The format we run: 3-round USCF dual-rated quad tournament (G/30), a catered sushi lunch from Mika, and a live master lecture — all included in one entry (typically ~$50–$65).
- Past event: Inaugural USCF Membership Drive — May 23, 2026 (5-round Swiss, G/30, 18 players, two divisions). A real, completed, USCF rated tournament.
- More info: https://cvchess.com/tournaments.html

## Closures
- July 1–8, 2026 — Summer Break
- October 12–16, 2026 — Fall Break
- Otherwise follows Carmel Unified School District calendar

## Frequently asked
- **Is there a chess club in Carmel Valley?** Yes — Carmel Valley Chess Club at 9 Del Fino Place, Suite 201.
- **Does my child need experience?** No. Coach JB welcomes complete beginners.
- **Can adults play here?** Yes — and so can the whole family. Family Chess Nights run one Friday a month, 5–9pm, all ages and all levels, with a 5–6pm beginner instruction hour. Donation-based, benefiting the youth scholarship fund. First one Friday July 17, 2026. Details: cvchess.com/friday-nights.html
- **Do you have summer camp?** Yes. Summer Chess Camp 2026 runs June 15–19, $500 all-inclusive.
- **What is a USCF rating?** An official numerical measure of chess strength tracked by the United States Chess Federation. Every camper and tournament player at CVCC receives a USCF membership and first rating.

## Free resources

- **Teach Your Kid Chess in 5 Days (Even If You Don't Play)** — A free series of five short videos from Coach JB, all delivered in a single email at signup. About 5 minutes per video. No chess experience needed; designed for parents who want to teach their child at home. Sign up: https://cvchess.com/join.html

## Upcoming programs (interest-gathering)

- **Charcuterie & Queens (Women's Night)** — A women's night out hosted by Halleh Bradley (Coach JB's wife) at Carmel Valley Chess Club. Mocktails and charcuterie catered by Carmel Valley Creamery, and a welcoming intro to chess for women of all skill levels; Halleh teaches the basics, no experience needed. First event: Friday, September 11, 2026, 7:00–8:30 PM. Registration open (space is limited): https://www.eventbrite.com/e/charcuterie-queens-learn-to-play-chess-a-womens-night-tickets-1995244586268. Details: https://cvchess.com/friday-nights.html#charcuterie-queens

## Press / media

- **The Carmel Pine Cone**, March 20, 2026 — feature article on Carmel Valley Chess Club, published before the grand opening. Read the issue: https://carmelpinecone.com/260320PC.pdf

## Brand voice
Founder-led. Direct. Specific. No corporate jargon. Coach JB speaks in first person and tells stories from the club. Avoid stock-photo language ("unleash your potential"). Avoid superlatives without proof. Lean into the small-batch, neighborhood-club identity.
